name: The Eye
overview: Scripture portrays the eye as a vital spiritual organ that influences the moral and spiritual condition of the whole person. Proverbs 7:2 emphasizes the preciousness of God's law, likening it to the 'apple of thine eye,' highlighting its cherished value. In the teachings of Jesus found in Matthew 6:22 and Luke 11:34, the eye is described as the 'light of the body,' where a single or healthy eye fills the whole body with light, symbolizing purity and spiritual clarity, whereas an evil eye results in darkness and moral corruption. Together, these verses reveal that the eye reflects the believer's focus and spiritual health, underscoring the importance of guarding one’s vision in accordance with God's truth.
